chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqteen, from his brother Al-Husayn, from Ali ibn Yaqteen, who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the wealth which is not worked with (in business) nor is it changed over. He (peace be upon him) said: 'The zakat is imposed upon it every year, except if it is cast (into a single mass/coin).'

key_terms.يُسْبَكَ: Cast / formed into a single mass (like a coin)

ai.seo_question: What is the zakat ruling on stored wealth that is not used for trade?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies that wealth held as savings (*mal al-munakh*) is subject to annual zakat unless it is 'cast' (*isbak*), a term often interpreted by Shia jurists as referring to gold and silver bullion or coins kept in their raw form rather than crafted into jewelry. This distinction highlights the Shia view that the exemption for ornaments applies specifically to items worn for adornment, whereas stored precious metals intended for wealth preservation are liable for zakat, reinforcing the principle of purifying stagnant assets. The ruling underscores the continuous obligation of zakat on capital that does not generate active trade profit but retains value, distinguishing it from the specific exemptions granted to wearable jewelry.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Yaqteen, from his brother Al Husayn, from Ali Bin Yaqteen who said,
‘I asked Abu Al-Hassanasws about the wealth which is not worked with (in business) nor is it changed over. Heasws said: ‘The Zakāt would be imposed upon it during every year, except if he casts it’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ’Isa from al-Hassan Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother al- Husayn from Ali ibn Yaqtin who has said the following: “I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about goods which are not used or moved. He (the Imam) said, ‘There is Zakat on it every year until it is used.”
